decision: After complete own-D0 raw/check closure, collect common-D0 from immutable initial capsules on audit workspaces while original read-only self-review and one compile-only repair proceed. Do not prepare or dispatch common quality judgments before own-final closes. Both acquisition batches retain the same two global native resource locks. Hidden inputs remain blocked until own-final.
basis: Pre-registered all-source-before-D0 barrier and frozen common-D0 launcher require d0-sources; no preregistered prohibition on anonymous public acquisition overlap. Generic scheduling only, not outcome-dependent source/evaluator changes.
costAttribution: Shared study scheduling, not exclusive v8 benefit; actual native/resource waits and consumer endpoints retain the overlap.
